details: Refuted.  On the three-code class, $\mathrm{OSC}=1$ but $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2$.  The cited order-compression theorem controls projected recursive teaching dimension for the given class; it does not justify maximizing a separate minimum-teaching quantity over all subclasses.
proof: The database-owned OSC value proof gives an improper order scheme of size one for the Three-Code Class, placing its missing center $001$ before its three members. The database-owned monotonic projected minimum teaching value is two: each target becomes the middle of a three-trace path on a suitable projection and requires two coordinates there. Thus $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2>1=\mathrm{OSC}$. The formerly quoted proper three-hypothesis order does not have width one on partial samples and is not used.
name: Order Sample Compression / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
